summary: Filomena Ristorante is confirmed at 1063 Wisconsin Avenue NW in Georgetown. All 45 frozen rows reconcile once: 31 exact products, 13 description fragments normalized to their dishes, and 1 section-heading artifact. Current official dinner, lunch, and dessert surfaces define 76 unique POC products. No formal allergen matrix was found after four searches; direct ingredient positives and Filomena's explicit restaurant-wide cross-contact warning are preserved without inferring allergen absence.
proposedChanges: Replace the PDF-fragment projection with the fully enumerated current dinner, lunch, and dessert product boundary.
Normalize thirteen description fragments to their containing products and remove the standalone Risotto heading artifact.
Add omitted dinner items, lunch-only items, and current desserts.
Preserve direct ingredient positives and the restaurant-issued all-menu cross-contact warning.

findings.finding: The frozen PDF extraction contains thirteen description fragments and one section heading rather than canonical products.
The frozen dinner-only projection omits current dinner items plus lunch-only and dessert products.
The official dinner menu explicitly warns of direct or cross-contact exposure to seven allergen groups.

coordinatorNotes: Current official menu index and linked PDFs/pages were used as the complete scope authority.
Wine/alcohol menu products were excluded from POC scope.
No unsupported allergen-negative or cross-contact safety claim was made.
